messages.subject: html file for "show in new window"
parts:
When I make a ggvis plot and click the "show in new window" button my browser opens
with a page named with the local IP and another number, that I assume identifies the page. Where is actually
the html file of that page?
I've searched that number on my disk and cannot find it.
Is it possible to insert that html code on another html file?
Thanks

"Can't output dynamic/interactive ggvis plots in a knitr document"
and the static plot. It would be good if I could include the link
to the page with the dynamic plot.
I know there are more sophisticated solutions through shiny, but
I find that too complicated. I prefer a more simple solution.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: html file for "show in new window"
parts:
ggvis is fundamentally tied to a running R session - this means that
you can do anything in ggvis that you can do in R. This means that it
will be harder to deploy than Rcharts, but it is not limited by what
someone else has implemented in javascript.

It is possible to embed a dynamic ggvis document in an interactive
Rmarkdown document: http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/authoring_shiny.html.
It's possible to publish these documents to a shiny server or
shinyapps.io.

Hadley
